# Quotation -- RAUTAPORTTI-RFQ-2026-09

Visakoivu Oy, Jyvaskyla -- technical maintenance framework agreement

## 3. Eligibility

3.1 Visakoivu Oy holds the required LUSA competence certificate.

## 4. Technical requirements

4.2 Service continuity through personnel changes is well covered: our LVI department alone has around 104 technicians, giving substantial depth so no single staff change affects service delivery on this framework.

4.5 Statutory periodic inspections of electrical installations are carried out in accordance with the required intervals.

4.7 All technicians deployed hold the qualifications required for their trade.

4.8 Installed equipment carries a standard warranty from commissioning.

## 5. Commercial terms

5.1 We accept a standard price-index clause reviewed annually.

5.4 Invoicing is monthly.

## 6. Forms

6.1 A certificate of pension insurance payments is attached.

6.2 An insurance certificate is attached.

## 7. Quotation format

7.2 The reference currency is EUR.

7.3 This quotation is submitted as a single PDF file.

## Liite A -- Tekninen erittely

2.1 We will provide a short training session for the buyer's property staff on our reporting system at contract start.

2.2 Installation work follows our standard method statement covering sequencing and handover.

3.2 Visakoivu already provides round-the-clock standby cover on other maintenance sites and confirms this will apply here as well.

## Liite B -- Lomakkeet ja kaupalliset ehdot

1.1 Subcontractor costs are itemised for transparency where relevant.
